description: Gaming PC build presets for the local GLM-5.1 UI — high-end configurations by budget and target

builds.name: Solid 1080p Gamer
builds.target: 1080p high settings, 60+ FPS in most titles
builds.prompt: Design an $800 USD gaming PC build for 1080p high settings. Include exact CPU, GPU, motherboard, RAM (speed/capacity), PSU (wattage + efficiency), case, and cooler. Explain why each part was chosen, list 2 alternative GPUs, note bottleneck risks, and give expected FPS in Fortnite, Cyberpunk 2077, and Baldur's Gate 3.

builds.name: 1440p High Refresh
builds.prompt: Design a $1400 USD gaming PC optimized for 1440p ultra settings at high refresh rates. Target 144+ FPS in esports and 80+ FPS in modern AAA. Include full parts list with prices, compatibility checks, airflow advice, and upgrade path for GPU in 2 years.

builds.name: 1440p Enthusiast
builds.prompt: Design a $2200 USD enthusiast 1440p gaming PC. Max settings, 144+ FPS in AAA titles. Include CPU/GPU pairing rationale, RAM tuning recommendations, case fan layout, and whether to prioritize AMD or Intel for this budget in 2026.

builds.name: 4K Ultra Gaming
builds.target: 4K ultra, 60–120 FPS with DLSS/FSR where needed
builds.prompt: Design a $3200 USD 4K ultra gaming PC. Target 60–120 FPS at 4K in modern AAA with DLSS/FSR. Full parts list, thermal analysis, monitor pairing recommendations (4K 144Hz vs OLED), and power draw estimate.

builds.name: Ultimate 4K / 240Hz
builds.target: Top-tier everything — 4K high refresh or ultrawide maxed
builds.prompt: Design a $5000 USD no-compromise gaming PC for 4K high refresh or ultrawide max settings. Use the best consumer parts available. Include flagship CPU/GPU, 64 GB RAM, premium motherboard, 1000W+ PSU, high-airflow case, and AIO or custom loop option. Compare vs prebuilt value.

builds.name: Game + Stream
builds.target: Play + stream at 1440p without frame drops
builds.prompt: Design a $2500 USD gaming + streaming PC. Must game at 1440p ultra while streaming to Twitch at 1080p60 with minimal FPS loss. Recommend CPU with strong multi-core, GPU with good encoder, 32 GB RAM, separate OS/game drive setup, and OBS settings guidance.

builds.name: VR Ready
builds.target: Quest 3 / Vision Pro class VR at high settings
builds.prompt: Design a $2000 USD VR gaming PC for Quest 3 / PCVR. Prioritize low latency, strong single-thread CPU, GPU for 90+ FPS per eye in Half-Life Alyx and Beat Saber mods. Include USB header planning, wireless vs wired Link notes, and recommended headsets.

builds.name: Small Form Factor LAN
builds.target: Portable LAN party build in ITX/SFF case
builds.prompt: Design an $1800 USD small form factor gaming PC in an ITX case for LAN parties. Maximize GPU size within SFF constraints, address thermals and noise, and list exact case + cooler + GPU length compatibility.
